comparison.objective: Commission a robot-axis damper vs plot a dead-reckoning position on a nautical chart.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-mediated adjustment and force-safe cycling vs scale interpretation, optional divider manipulation, and precise marker placement.

comparison.reason: Measurement-based reasoning is shared only abstractly; the physical mechanisms and tested outcomes are unrelated.
